archetypes.name: shell-rebuild
archetypes.rationale: Final publish now recreates worktrees and should be reviewed for git-state edge cases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on scripts/design-log-publish.sh final-mode rebuild semantics. Check that the fresh fetch, worktree recreation, delete-aware overlay, idempotency comparison, commit, and push paths preserve pause behavior and recovery behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-realism
archetypes.rationale: The regression harness simulates stale refs, branch replacement, and default advancement.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new shell harness scenarios for realism and determinism. Pay special attention to git wrapper behavior, PATH contamination between cases, and whether assertions would fail on the original stale-base bug. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
